fixes.explanation: Micah says the remnant will be "…like a lion among the beasts of the forest…" (Micah 5:8). Hold up, we just had soft dew a verse ago, and now we've got a lion! Micah doesn't stay in one picture for long.
The LORD says, "I will remove your horses from among you and wreck your chariots." (Micah 5:10). Horses and chariots go together, so He takes both. Chariots are the word that fills this blank.
The LORD says, "I will cut the sorceries from your hand, and you will have no fortune-tellers." (Micah 5:12). Sorceries go and fortune-tellers go with them. That's the word for the blank.

The LORD says, "I will also cut off the carved images and sacred pillars from among you, so that you will no longer bow down to the work of your own hands." (Micah 5:13). The reason is right there in the verse. People were bowing to something their own hands made.

The LORD says, "I will take vengeance in anger and wrath upon the nations that have not obeyed Me." (Micah 5:15). The text names one thing about these nations, that they have not obeyed Him. That's the whole description.
